# Dot-com vs AI Bubble Comparison Dataset

## Overview
Four datasets capturing key market metrics across two technology-driven market booms: the 1997–2002 dot-com era and the 2021–2024 AI era. The data is structured for side-by-side temporal alignment using a common `quarter_offset` or `year` field within each era.

## Data Source

### nasdaq_index
Quarterly NASDAQ Composite closing values, rebased to 100 at the start of each era. Fields: `era` (string: "Dot-com" or "AI"), `quarter_offset` (integer 0–23), `label` (calendar quarter string), `index_value` (float). The dot-com series spans 24 quarters (1997-Q1 to 2002-Q4); the AI series spans 16 quarters (2021-Q1 to 2024-Q4).

### pe_ratio
Trailing 12-month P/E ratio for the NASDAQ Composite, sampled at irregular quarterly intervals. Fields: `era`, `quarter_offset`, `label`, `pe` (float, ratio). Dot-com P/E ranges from ~28 to ~105; AI-era P/E ranges from ~24 to ~40.

### ipo_counts
Annual count of technology-sector IPOs on US exchanges. Fields: `era`, `year` (integer), `ipo_count` (integer). Dot-com era: 6 years; AI era: 4 years.

### corporate_earnings
Aggregate annual net income for NASDAQ-100 companies in nominal billion USD. Fields: `era`, `year`, `earnings_bn` (float; may be negative). Dot-com earnings range from −12.3 to 30.5 B; AI-era earnings range from 358 to 510 B.

## Data Notes
- NASDAQ index values are rebased independently per era; absolute levels differ dramatically.
- P/E ratios for the dot-com era include periods of near-zero aggregate earnings, inflating the ratio.
- Nominal earnings are not inflation-adjusted; direct magnitude comparison across eras should note the ~20-year gap.
- 2024 figures are estimates based on analyst consensus as of late 2024.

import json
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np

with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# Colors — editorial palette
C_DOTCOM = '#c0392b'
C_AI = '#2980b9'
C_DOTCOM_LIGHT = '#e8c4c0'
C_AI_LIGHT = '#b8d4e8'
BG = '#fafaf7'
GRID_C = '#d5d5d0'
TEXT_C = '#2c2c2c'
SUBTLE = '#888888'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.sans-serif': ['DejaVu Sans'],
    'font.size': 9,
    'axes.facecolor': BG,
    'figure.facecolor': BG,
    'axes.edgecolor': GRID_C,
    'axes.labelcolor': TEXT_C,
    'xtick.color': SUBTLE,
    'ytick.color': SUBTLE,
    'text.color': TEXT_C,
})

fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.subplots_adjust(hspace=0.38, wspace=0.30, top=0.88, bottom=0.07, left=0.08, right=0.95)

fig.suptitle('Dot-com vs AI Era: Anatomy of a Tech Bubble?',
             fontsize=17, fontweight='bold', y=0.96, color=TEXT_C)
fig.text(0.5, 0.925, 'NASDAQ index, valuations, IPO activity, and earnings — two eras aligned quarter-by-quarter',
         ha='center', fontsize=10, color=SUBTLE)

# --- helpers ---
def style_ax(ax, ylabel, title):
    ax.set_title(title, fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', loc='left', pad=8)
    ax.set_ylabel(ylabel, fontsize=9)
    ax.set_xlabel('Quarters from era start', fontsize=9)
    ax.grid(axis='y', color=GRID_C, linewidth=0.5, alpha=0.7)
    ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines['right'].set_visible(False)
    ax.tick_params(length=3)

def era_legend(ax):
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8, loc='upper left')

# ============ Panel A: NASDAQ Index ============
ax = axes[0, 0]
ni = data['nasdaq_index']['data']
dc_q = [d['quarter_offset'] for d in ni if d['era']=='Dot-com']
dc_v = [d['index_value'] for d in ni if d['era']=='Dot-com']
ai_q = [d['quarter_offset'] for d in ni if d['era']=='AI']
ai_v = [d['index_value'] for d in ni if d['era']=='AI']

ax.plot(dc_q, dc_v, color=C_DOTCOM, linewidth=2, label='Dot-com (1997–2002)')
ax.plot(ai_q, ai_v, color=C_AI, linewidth=2, label='AI era (2021–2024)')

# Peak markers
dc_peak_idx = dc_v.index(max(dc_v))
ax.annotate('Peak: 2000-Q1\n305.2', xy=(dc_q[dc_peak_idx], dc_v[dc_peak_idx]),
            xytext=(dc_q[dc_peak_idx]+2, dc_v[dc_peak_idx]+15),
            fontsize=7.5, color=C_DOTCOM, fontweight='bold',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_DOTCOM, lw=1))
ax.plot(dc_q[dc_peak_idx], dc_v[dc_peak_idx], 'o', color=C_DOTCOM, markersize=7, zorder=5)

ai_peak_idx = ai_v.index(max(ai_v))
ax.annotate('High: 2024-Q4\n148.7', xy=(ai_q[ai_peak_idx], ai_v[ai_peak_idx]),
            xytext=(ai_q[ai_peak_idx]-4, ai_v[ai_peak_idx]+40),
            fontsize=7.5, color=C_AI, fontweight='bold',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_AI, lw=1))
ax.plot(ai_q[ai_peak_idx], ai_v[ai_peak_idx], 'o', color=C_AI, markersize=7, zorder=5)

style_ax(ax, 'Index (base = 100)', 'A. NASDAQ Composite Trajectory')
era_legend(ax)

# ============ Panel B: P/E Ratio ============
ax = axes[0, 1]
pe = data['pe_ratio']['data']
dc_pq = [d['quarter_offset'] for d in pe if d['era']=='Dot-com']
dc_pe = [d['pe'] for d in pe if d['era']=='Dot-com']
ai_pq = [d['quarter_offset'] for d in pe if d['era']=='AI']
ai_pe = [d['pe'] for d in pe if d['era']=='AI']

ax.fill_between(dc_pq, dc_pe, alpha=0.15, color=C_DOTCOM)
ax.fill_between(ai_pq, ai_pe, alpha=0.15, color=C_AI)
ax.plot(dc_pq, dc_pe, color=C_DOTCOM, linewidth=2, marker='o', markersize=4, label='Dot-com')
ax.plot(ai_pq, ai_pe, color=C_AI, linewidth=2, marker='s', markersize=4, label='AI era')

# Highlight dot-com peak PE
dc_pe_peak = max(dc_pe)
dc_pe_peak_q = dc_pq[dc_pe.index(dc_pe_peak)]
ax.annotate(f'105.2×', xy=(dc_pe_peak_q, dc_pe_peak),
            xytext=(dc_pe_peak_q+2, dc_pe_peak+5),
            fontsize=8, color=C_DOTCOM, fontweight='bold',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_DOTCOM, lw=1))

ai_pe_peak = max(ai_pe)
ai_pe_peak_q = ai_pq[ai_pe.index(ai_pe_peak)]
ax.annotate(f'40.3×', xy=(ai_pe_peak_q, ai_pe_peak),
            xytext=(ai_pe_peak_q-4, ai_pe_peak+20),
            fontsize=8, color=C_AI, fontweight='bold',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_AI, lw=1))

style_ax(ax, 'Trailing P/E ratio (×)', 'B. Valuation: P/E Ratio Divergence')
era_legend(ax)

# ============ Panel C: IPO Counts ============
ax = axes[1, 0]
ipo = data['ipo_counts']['data']
dc_years = [d['year'] for d in ipo if d['era']=='Dot-com']
dc_ipo = [d['ipo_count'] for d in ipo if d['era']=='Dot-com']
ai_years = [d['year'] for d in ipo if d['era']=='AI']
ai_ipo = [d['ipo_count'] for d in ipo if d['era']=='AI']

yr_offset_dc = list(range(len(dc_years)))
yr_offset_ai = list(range(len(ai_years)))

w = 0.35
bars1 = ax.bar([x - w/2 for x in yr_offset_dc], dc_ipo, w, color=C_DOTCOM, label='Dot-com', alpha=0.85)
bars2 = ax.bar([x + w/2 for x in yr_offset_ai], ai_ipo, w, color=C_AI, label='AI era', alpha=0.85)

for bar, val in zip(bars1, dc_ipo):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height()+5, str(val),
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7, color=C_DOTCOM, fontweight='bold')
for bar, val in zip(bars2, ai_ipo):
    ax.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2, bar.get_height()+5, str(val),
            ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=7, color=C_AI, fontweight='bold')

# X labels: show both eras
xlabels = [f'{dc_years[i]}\n{ai_years[i]}' if i < len(ai_years) else f'{dc_years[i]}\n—' for i in range(len(dc_years))]
ax.set_xticks(yr_offset_dc)
ax.set_xticklabels(xlabels, fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('Year (Dot-com top / AI era bottom)', fontsize=9)

style_ax(ax, 'Tech IPOs (count)', 'C. IPO Frenzy: Volume Comparison')
era_legend(ax)

# ============ Panel D: Corporate Earnings ============
ax = axes[1, 1]
earn = data['corporate_earnings']['data']
dc_ey = [d['year'] for d in earn if d['era']=='Dot-com']
dc_eb = [d['earnings_bn'] for d in earn if d['era']=='Dot-com']
ai_ey = [d['year'] for d in earn if d['era']=='AI']
ai_eb = [d['earnings_bn'] for d in earn if d['era']=='AI']

yr_off_dc = list(range(len(dc_ey)))
yr_off_ai = list(range(len(ai_ey)))

ax2 = ax.twinx()

ax.bar([x - w/2 for x in yr_off_dc], dc_eb, w, color=C_DOTCOM, alpha=0.85, label='Dot-com earnings')
ax2.bar([x + w/2 for x in yr_off_ai], ai_eb, w, color=C_AI, alpha=0.85, label='AI era earnings')

ax.set_ylabel('Dot-com earnings ($B)', fontsize=9, color=C_DOTCOM)
ax2.set_ylabel('AI era earnings ($B)', fontsize=9, color=C_AI)
ax.tick_params(axis='y', colors=C_DOTCOM)
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', colors=C_AI)
ax2.spines['right'].set_visible(True)
ax2.spines['right'].set_color(C_AI)
ax.spines['left'].set_color(C_DOTCOM)

# Zero line for dot-com
ax.axhline(0, color=C_DOTCOM, linewidth=0.5, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)

xlabels2 = [f'{dc_ey[i]}\n{ai_ey[i]}' if i < len(ai_ey) else f'{dc_ey[i]}\n—' for i in range(len(dc_ey))]
ax.set_xticks(yr_off_dc)
ax.set_xticklabels(xlabels2, fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel('Year (Dot-com top / AI era bottom)', fontsize=9)

# Combine legends
lines1, labels1 = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(lines1+lines2, labels1+labels2, frameon=False, fontsize=8, loc='upper left')

style_ax(ax, '', 'D. Earnings Backdrop: Do Profits Justify Prices?')
ax.spines['top'].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['top'].set_visible(False)

# Annotate key insight
ax.annotate('Dot-com losses\nin 2001: −$12.3B', xy=(4, -12.3),
            xytext=(4.5, -25), fontsize=7.5, color=C_DOTCOM, fontweight='bold',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_DOTCOM, lw=1))

plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=180, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor=BG)
print('Chart saved.')
